test_title: PYST 4: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

No one could have anticipated such a diplomatic backlash.

options.text: Such a diplomatic backlash could not be anticipated.
Such a diplomatic backlash have not been anticipated.
Such a diplomatic backlash was unanticipated.
Such a diplomatic backlash could not have been anticipated

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. Such a diplomatic backlash could not have been anticipated .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **active voice**, where the subject ("No one") performs the action.
 
• To change it into the **passive voice**, the object ("such a diplomatic backlash") becomes the subject of the sentence.
 
• The structure for converting to the passive voice is: **Object + modal + have been + past participle**.
 
• The correct transformation is: **Such a diplomatic backlash could not have been anticipated**.

Correct sentence: *Such a diplomatic backlash could not have been anticipated*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active Voice:**
 
 
• The subject of the sentence performs the action.
 
• **Example:** She wrote a letter.
 
 
 
• **Passive Voice:**
 
 
• The subject of the sentence receives the action.
 
• **Example:** A letter was written by her.
 
 
 
• **Key Formula for Passive Voice with Modals:** Object + modal + have been + past participle
